newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Three Israeli soldiers killed in Lebanon fighting.
newsitem.headline: Three Israeli soldiers killed in Lebanon fighting.

text.p: Three Israeli soldiers were killed and seven wounded on Thursday in fierce clashes with Hizbollah guerrillas in south Lebanon, the Israeli army said on Friday.
Pro-Israeli militia sources had initially reported that one soldier was killed and five wounded in the fighting.
An Israeli army spokeswoman said one soldier was killed in an initial clash and two more died during evacuation efforts.
"At least two terrorists were killed," she added.
A spokesman for the Shi'ite Moslem Hizbollah (Party of God) in Beirut had earlier denied reports any guerrillas were killed.

Lebanese security sources said Israeli helicopters subsequently twice struck Hizbollah bases just outside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone. In a separate air raid, a helicopter rocketed a Lebanese army checkpoint north of the zone, they said.

The fighting on the last active Arab-Israeli warfront came on the eve of Ashoura, the day in the Shi'ite Moslem calendar marking the climax of a period mourning the death in battle in AD 680 of the grandson of the Prophet Mohammad.
The fighting occurred as a group of Israeli soldiers got caught in a guerrilla ambush in ad-Dahr Daidaba south of Syrian-controlled Bekaa valley, two kms (one mile) north of Israel's occupation zone.
"Fighting erupted with machineguns and rocket-propelled grenades when Israeli soldiers on a military mission got ambushed by an armed group near the Rihan area," a pro-Israeli militia source said.
In Beirut, the pro-Iranian Hizbollah said its guerrillas ambushed the group as they attempted to infiltrate outside the zone.

The late night attack brought to nine the number of Israeli soldiers killed and to 35 the number of those wounded in guerrilla attacks in south Lebanon this year. Last year, 27 Israeli soldiers were killed in Lebanon.
Thursday's attack was the fifth fatal one against Israeli forces in south Lebanon in 1997. Three Israeli soldiers were killed by a roadside bomb set by Hizbollah in January.
Hizbollah leads an Islamic Resistance fighting to oust Israeli troops and their local South Lebanon Army militia allies from the 15-km (nine-mile) wide occupation zone in south Lebanon.
Lebanese security sources said an Israeli helicopter fired four rockets in two runs into the hills of Jabal ad-Dahr near the fighting site.

Shortly after midnight, an Israeli helicopter fired one rocket into a Lebanese army checkpoint setting a Lebanese army vehicle ablaze in Zellaya in the western side of the Bekaa Valley, five km (three miles) north of the zone, the sources said. They mentioned no casualties.
The attacks brought to 30 the number of Israeli air raids into Lebanon in 1997.
